title: My date showed up wearing my jacket

hooks.text: My date showed up wearing my jacket.
I recognized the coffee stain before I recognized him.
First date, and he was wearing something I sold.

beats.text: My date showed up wearing *my* jacket.
beats.visual: Cafe terrace. Tiff at a table; a guy in an olive jacket walks up; Tiff freezes.

beats.text: Not one like mine. *Mine*. The olive one with the coffee stain on the sleeve.
beats.visual: Close on the jacket sleeve: a brown stain; Tiff squints, magnifier.

beats.text: I sold it online in March, to clear out my *chair*.
beats.visual: Flashback: Tiff's bedroom, the clothes chair; she folds the jacket into a box.

beats.text: And now he's telling me it's his *favorite* thing he owns.
beats.visual: Back at the cafe. The guy beams, hand on his chest; Tiff smiles stiffly.

beats.text: He found it secondhand, and it just *fit*.
beats.visual: He does a little spin; hearts pop.

beats.text: Do I tell him? On a *first* date?
Then he spills his coffee. On the *same* sleeve.
beats.visual: The cup tips; SPLASH on the same sleeve; Tiff covers her mouth.

beats.text: So I told him. He laughed so hard he *cried*.
beats.visual: Both laughing at the table; tears of laughter.

beats.text: Second date's Friday. He's wearing it *again*.
beats.visual: He waves goodbye in the jacket; Tiff waves back, blushing.

beats.text: Your pile could be someone's favorite thing. I list mine with *pileGo*.
beats.visual: Quick plug: Tiff at home next to her chair, a pileGo! sign pops up, marketplace boards light up.
